verdict.rationale: The evidence documents the Cloud Console, a Terraform provider, REST/gRPC APIs with generated clients, and kubeconfig downloads for use with kubectl. None of these is an official CoreWeave CLI: kubectl is a host-platform Kubernetes tool, and Terraform and the SDKs are adjacent building blocks. No first-party CoreWeave command-line tool appears anywhere in the pack.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
